site.name: YPDC UON
site.intro: A dynamic platform for leadership, personal growth, community engagement and meaningful impact. Join a network that turns ideas into action.
aboutProse: The Young Peace and Development Corps (YPDC) at the University of Narowal is a student-led corps that builds leadership, civic responsibility and practical skills through real projects, events and community service.
Seven directorates work as one connected system — planning activities, mentoring members and delivering measurable impact in the campus and the wider Narowal community.
site.vision: To develop a generation of confident, peaceful and service-driven student leaders who create lasting positive change in society.
site.mission: To provide students a structured platform for leadership, professional growth, volunteerism, peacebuilding and community development through seven focused directorates.

contact.office: Student Affairs Office, University of Narowal, Shakargarh Road, Narowal, Punjab
